name: onboarder-takes-theirs
source: Hand-written. 0075 table row 'An answer to an onboarder question: taken from theirs, the org wins'. Contract rule: Answers, onboarder question. The newcomer's hand edit of repo_url is replaced. An answer that equals theirs is not reported.

name: onboarder-answer-removed-or-deferred-by-the-org
source: Hand-written. Brief: for an onboarder question, absent in theirs means unanswered. 0035: Deferred is a value. A theirs answer that is Deferred replaces a text, and a text replaces Deferred.

name: audience-defaults-to-onboarder
source: Hand-written. 0055: the audience is onboarder by default. Brief: use the variable's audience in theirs, default onboarder. A variable with no audience behaves as an explicit onboarder one.

name: onboardee-answer-not-changed-takes-theirs
source: Hand-written. 0075 table row 'An answer to an onboardee question that the newcomer has not changed from base: taken from theirs, so a changed pre-seed reaches them'. Both absent counts equal, so a new pre-seed arrives. Theirs absent clears an unchanged answer. Deferred equals Deferred.

name: onboardee-answer-changed-is-kept
source: Hand-written. 0075 table row 'An answer to an onboardee question that the newcomer changed: kept. The newcomer wins'. laptop_os is kept even though theirs holds the same value. account_name was cleared by the newcomer, so it stays unanswered. shell had no value in base, so any answer in ours is a change.

name: equality-by-kind-and-order
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: Equal answers. Two answers are equal when both are absent, or have the same kind and the same content. A list is equal only in the same order. The Text true differs from the Flag true. The Text deferred differs from Deferred. Empty text, a false flag, and an empty list each differ from absent.

name: choice-no-longer-listed-needs-review
source: Hand-written. 0075 table row 'An answer that is no longer valid, such as a choice option that was removed: marked as needing review. Never kept silently'. Contract rule: Valid answers. A choice takes text equal to one of its options, with case. The removed answer is not in the plan and is listed for review. A neighbour in the same section stays.

name: kind-no-longer-fits-needs-review
source: Hand-written. Brief: a kept onboardee answer whose kind no longer fits the variable type is removed and reported for review. Contract rule: Valid answers. A boolean takes a flag. A command, or a variable with multiple, takes a list. Anything else takes text, and a single contact does not take a list. A choice with multiple takes a list whose non-empty items are all options.

name: answers-that-are-not-checked-stay
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: Valid answers. A Deferred answer and an answer that is not settled (0035: empty text, an empty list, a list of only empty text) are valid for any variable. Options limit only a choice. A pattern is not checked here, and the plan validator reports it.

name: only-a-kept-answer-is-checked
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: Valid answers. Validity is judged for a newcomer's answer that is kept. An answer taken from theirs is the organization's, and the plan validator judges it. An unchanged old answer takes theirs and needs no review.

name: new-question
source: Hand-written. 0075 table row 'A new onboardee question: appears unanswered'. Contract rule: Report. A question is new when theirs declares it and ours does not. A pre-seeded new question is also taken. A new question in an existing section is new too.

name: new-is-judged-against-ours
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: Report. The questions and sections ours declares are the ones the newcomer has seen. A question that ours has and base lacks is not new. One that base has and ours lacks is new.

name: new-and-removed-sections
source: Hand-written. 0075 table row 'A new section or step: appears as not done'. Contract rule: Report. A new section brings its questions as new questions. A removed section is listed with its questions, and its stored answers stay. The result holds the sections of theirs in their order.

name: removed-question-is-hidden-not-deleted
source: Hand-written. 0075 table row 'A question that disappeared: the answer is kept but hidden, not deleted'. Brief: answers for a question not declared in theirs are kept untouched, in both scopes. Theirs holds answers for questions it no longer declares, and they are not copied.

name: returning-question-brings-its-hidden-answer-back
source: Hand-written. 0075 table: a hidden answer is kept 'in case it returns'. Contract rule: Answers. A hidden answer is a stored answer like any other once theirs declares the question: an onboardee question keeps it when it differs from base, and an onboarder question takes theirs. The question is new, because ours did not declare it.

name: moved-question-is-gone-and-new
source: Hand-written. Brief: a question moved between scopes is not a move. The old one is gone, so its answer is hidden, and the new one is new and unanswered.

name: scopes-are-separate
source: Hand-written. 0075 and the domain model: a question is `<scope>.<name>`. One name in the plan and in two sections is three questions, each judged on its own.

name: answers-with-no-question-in-theirs
source: Hand-written. Brief: answers for a question not declared in theirs are kept untouched, in both scopes. Contract rule: Answers. An answer in theirs for a question theirs does not declare is not copied, and an answer in ours for a section or name that theirs does not declare is left as it is.

name: content-comes-from-theirs
source: Hand-written. 0075: content (sections, variables, unknown fields) is taken from theirs, and a hand edit does not last. Contract rule: Result. The plan's own id, schemaVersion, and provenance stay as they were. The section switch, the source, and the order of sections come from theirs, and unknown fields of the plan and of a section come from theirs.

name: first-refresh-and-the-origin-passed-in
source: Hand-written. 0075: the origin records where the org plan came from, the hash, and the date. Brief: the plan id is taken from theirs, and a first refresh, with an empty origin plan id in ours, is accepted. A plan id carried in the origin argument is ignored.

name: later-refresh-replaces-the-origin
source: Hand-written. 0075: the origin records the hash it was last refreshed from. An origin plan id in ours that equals theirs.id is accepted, and source, hash, and date are replaced.

name: refuse-a-different-organization
source: Hand-written. 0075: a different id means a different organization, and the refresh refuses. Contract rule: Refusing. The plan comes back as it was, the report is empty, and one problem says which ids differ.

name: refuse-an-org-plan-with-no-id
source: Hand-written. Brief: refuse when theirs.id is empty. The personal plan, including its answers and its origin, comes back unchanged.

name: missing-id-is-the-only-problem-when-both-apply
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: Refusing. When theirs has no id, the only problem is the missing id, even if ours records another plan id.

name: nothing-changed
source: Hand-written. 0075: a refresh of an unchanged org plan changes nothing but the origin. Contract rule: Report. Every list is empty, and an answer that is the same in theirs is not taken.

name: audience-comes-from-theirs
source: Hand-written. Brief: use the variable's audience in theirs. A question that became onboardee keeps the newcomer's changed answer. A question that became onboarder takes theirs.

name: no-base-answers-keeps-every-newcomer-answer
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: Equal answers. The base is read for answers only. With an empty base, every onboardee answer in ours differs from base, so none is replaced. The base's own id is not checked.

name: report-lists-are-sorted-by-whole-id
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: Report. Each list is sorted by the bytes of the whole id, `<scope>.<name>`, with no repeats. Sorting by scope and then name gives another order for access-x.a, and sorting without regard to case does too. The sections list is sorted by id.

name: plans-with-no-answers-at-all
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: Answers. A plan with no answers, no maps, is an ordinary input. Nothing fails, and the answers of theirs that are for onboarder questions arrive.

name: a-taken-list-is-copied
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: Properties. The result shares no list or map with an argument, so changing the result cannot change theirs. The test changes every list and map in the result, then checks the inputs.

name: multiple-choice-checks-every-item
source: Hand-written. 0035: an empty item is not settled content, so it is not judged against the options. Contract rule: Valid answers, with multiple every item that is not empty must be an option. An invalid item first or last in the list is invalid. An empty item first or last beside valid options is valid.

name: hidden-list-answers-are-copied
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: Where answers are written, the result shares no map or list in answers with an argument. List answers for questions theirs does not declare, in the plan scope, a declared section, and an undeclared section, are left as they are and are still copies.

name: answers-removed-leave-no-entry-and-no-empty-section
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: Where answers are written, an entry that is removed leaves no entry of no kind behind, and the result may hold no empty map for a section. Every answer of the section access is removed by theirs, so no entry and no map for access remains.

name: directory-comes-from-theirs
source: Hand-written. 0075 table row 'Content: sections, variables, the directory: taken from theirs'. 0080 'A directory in the org plan'. Ours holds an older directory and base another. The result holds theirs exactly, with no entry of ours or base merged in, and a team's holder map comes along.

name: directory-removed-by-theirs-is-removed
source: Hand-written. 0075: the directory is content taken from theirs, so a theirs with no directory leaves the personal plan with none. A merge or a keep-ours rule would leave the old entries.

name: id-not-in-theirs-directory-needs-review
source: Hand-written. 0075 table row 'An answer that is no longer valid, such as ... a team that no longer exists: marked as needing review and asked again'. 0080 'An answer that names an id that is not in the directory counts as unanswered'. Kept answers are checked against the directory of theirs, not ours or base: lee-park is only in ours and is removed, it-help is only in theirs and stays. Covers the three types and a section question.

name: id-must-be-in-the-list-for-its-type
source: Hand-written. 0080: contact, role, and team ids are separate lists, and ids are lowercase slugs. A role id is not a contact, a contact id is not a role, and a team id is not a contact. The match is exact: Sam-Okafor and the name Sam Okafor are not the id sam-okafor.

name: no-directory-in-theirs-means-every-id-is-missing
source: Hand-written. 0075: the directory comes from theirs. 0080: an id that is not in the directory is unanswered. Ours has a directory that names all of them, and theirs has none, so every kept answer is removed and listed. A check that skips an empty directory keeps them.

name: multiple-list-drops-only-the-missing-ids
source: Hand-written. 0080: a multiple contact or role question holds an ordered list, and an id that is not in the directory counts as unanswered. Only the missing ids go and the rest keep their order. The question is listed for review, not as kept. A list with nothing left to keep is removed. Empty items are not ids and are left alone, as for choice options. An empty list and a list of only blank text are not settled, so they stay (0035).

name: kind-fit-for-contact-role-and-team
source: Hand-written. Contract rule on valid answers, decision by the person for the directory types: contact and role take text, or a list when multiple. A team takes text only, so a multiple flag on a team does not make a list fit. A flag fits none. Deferred and empty text are not settled and stay (0035).

name: only-a-kept-directory-answer-is-checked
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: an answer from theirs is not checked, only a kept onboardee answer is, and a hidden answer is left exactly as it is. 0075: onboarder answers and unchanged onboardee answers are taken from theirs. Taken answers name ids that theirs does not list and are still taken. An unchanged answer that names an id gone from the directory is replaced by theirs, so it is not reported for review. A hidden answer naming a missing id stays.

name: refusal-keeps-our-directory
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: a refusal returns ours as it was. A refused refresh does not take the directory of theirs and does not clear an answer.
